explanation: The approved version 1 terms omitted the add-back for restructuring charges allowed by Amendment No. 2 effective 2026-04-01. This amendment permits add-back of restructuring charges deducted in net income up to $500,000 for any test period (Amd 2 §3). Financials show $620,000 restructuring charges incurred, capped to $500,000 allowed by the add-back. Including this add-back alongside Consolidated EBITDA, unfinanced capex, cash taxes, scheduled principal, and cash interest (all cited from Financials Q2 2026 §1 and §2) and recalculating yields a DSCR of 1.28 (fb25e864-aec6-4e34-a9f2-d1c6e7a0bf52), exceeding the minimum 1.25 (CA §7.11(a)). Our initial calculation on boarded terms gave 1.12, below 1.25 (calc_id 804239d4-264a-47d2-9572-42cd30b15de6). Thus, the exception results from not considering the amendment add-back and is resolved by applying the amendment correctly.
confidence_basis: The last calculator call on corrected terms including the add-back for restructuring charges capped at $500,000 permitted by Amendment No. 2 passed the covenant test with a DSCR above 1.25.

claims.text: Borrower shall not permit DSCR less than 1.25 tested last day of each fiscal quarter on trailing four-quarter basis.
claims.quote: The Borrower shall not permit the Debt Service Coverage Ratio, tested as of the last day of each fiscal quarter on a trailing four-quarter basis, to be less than 1.25 to 1.00.

claims.text: DSCR defined as Consolidated EBITDA plus permitted add-backs minus unfinanced capex and cash taxes, over Debt Service of scheduled principal plus cash interest.
claims.quote: "Debt Service Coverage Ratio" means, for any period, the ratio of (i) Consolidated EBITDA for that period, plus any add-back permitted by Section 7.11, minus Unfinanced Capital Expenditures and cash taxes paid during that period, to (ii) Debt Service for that period.

claims.text: Debt Service consists of scheduled principal and cash interest payments for the test period.
claims.quote: "Debt Service" means, for any period, the sum of (i) scheduled principal payments on Indebtedness and (ii) cash interest paid on Indebtedness, in each case during that period.

claims.text: Amendment No. 2 effective 2026-04-01 permits add-back for restructuring charges deducted in net income capped at $500,000 per test period.
claims.quote: Section 7.11(b) of the Credit Agreement is amended so that, in addition to any add-back already permitted there, the Borrower may add back restructuring charges, to the extent deducted in determining net income, in an aggregate amount not to exceed $500,000 for any test period.
